I can see Blake is 5 years old but does not live with you, and you contribute £10.00 per week towards their upkeep.

However, apprenticeships in Scotland may be structured differently and could potentially qualify as approved education or training, which would maintain eligibility until age 20. The information provided doesn't give me clear guidance on whether Scottish apprenticeships are treated the same as English apprenticeships for Child Benefit purposes.
